input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 provides automatic one-year (not multi-year) renewals, which is acceptable, but the non-renewal notice window is 90 days. That exceeds the fallback ceiling of 60 days (and the preferred 30 days), so it fails the fallback on a material term, though it stops short of walk-away territory (>90 days). The redline shortens only the Company's notice window to 30 days, preserving HDI's 90-day window so our own notice protection is not diluted, and adds the preferred 60-day renewal reminder. The agreement contains no renewal price-uplift language, so no uplift cap is proposed; that is noted here rather than flagged separately.

proposal.summary: Shorten the Company's non-renewal notice window from 90 to 30 days (HDI's window unchanged) and add a 60-day renewal reminder.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have shortened our non-renewal notice window from 90 to 30 days (leaving HDI's 90-day window intact) and added a 60-day renewal reminder, consistent with our position that automatic 12-month renewals must be easy for us to exit. If helpful, we can accept a 60-day window for the Company as a fallback.

ops.oldText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other. Such notice shall specify the date on which this Agreement is to be terminated (the "Termination Date").
ops.newText: unless terminated by the Company upon thirty (30) days written notice to HDI, or by HDI upon ninety (90) days written notice to the Company. Such notice shall specify the date on which this Agreement is to be terminated (the "Termination Date"). HDI shall notify the Company in writing of each upcoming automatic renewal not less than sixty (60) days prior to the applicable anniversary of the Effective Date.
